Title: Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Stack

Body.Content:
Azure Stack operators or tenants can now replicate and failover Windows Server and Linux guest OS based application deployed in IaaS VMs on Azure Stack to Azure. This new ability gives operators and tenants more options when developing a disaster recovery strategy for Azure Stack.

Learn more about key features and concepts in Azure Stack.
